summary: ABF. Not found in the IND sponsor register. 100% of its 2 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 1 about legal trouble, strikes or bankruptcy.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants
Google News RSS (headline and link only), last 90 days, fetched 2026-10-06

insights.one_liner: ABF is a Roosendaal trading and e-commerce company with 10 million products in stock, an in-house dev team, and mostly foreign customers.

culture.text: It calls itself an e-commerce business with a strong IT focus and an in-house development team that improves its software daily.
It describes a conservative market but a company that is not conservative itself.
Its 2 open jobs here are in data and software engineering, both in Roosendaal.

open.text: Only 6% of its customers are in the Netherlands, so the work is very international.
Both current postings need no Dutch, mention visa or relocation and show pay, but average about 200 LinkedIn applicants.
ABF is not listed as an IND recognised sponsor.
